meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成一步步可核对的执行,跑到一半也能存档接着跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑多步骤长任务,又希望中途能停、断了能接着跑
copy.tagline_en: Break a big goal into verifiable steps and run it through, resuming anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run long multi-step tasks and want to pause and resume safely

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把目标注册进 .omo/ulw-loop 的 CLI 状态,拆成一条条原子步骤并同步到实时清单,每个成功标准都绑定真实界面上的证据;上下文丢失后先重读简报、目标与台账再继续,不从零重规划。
howto.when: 当你要求 ulw-loop、ulw,或持久可断点续跑的目标执行、带证据的工作、手动 QA 时接管。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这项工作拆成带证据的步骤并先建目标
say.note: 它会先注册目标再开始执行

say.text: 查一下当前 ulw-loop 的状态和已完成步骤的证据
say.note: 按会话读取 CLI 状态与台账

say.text: 这个会话的目标已完成,用新的 session-id 开一件新工作
say.note: 不会去改写已完成的旧状态

howto.what_en: Claude registers goals via the ulw-loop CLI under .omo/ulw-loop, mirrors each atomic step into a live checklist, and binds success criteria to real-surface evidence; after context loss it re-reads brief, goals and ledger before resuming.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop, ulw, durable checkpointed goal execution, evidence-led work or manual QA.

say_en.text: Run ulw-loop to break this work into evidence-bound steps and register the goals
Show the current ulw-loop status and the evidence for each finished step
say_en.note: Reads CLI state and ledger for the session

say_en.text: This session's goals are complete; start new work with a fresh session-id
